say:2:1720822002:1.text: The person behind you... Valen? What are you doing back in the capital?
say:2:1720822002:1.source_cn: 站在你身后的人是……维伦？你怎么回王都了？

say:5:1720822004:1.text: We do, but not from the Solitaries.
say:5:1720822004:1.source_cn: 没错，不过不是在隐士认识的。
say:5:1720822004:1.male: We do, but not from the Solitaries.
say:5:1720822004:1.female: We do, but not from the Solitaries.

say:6:1720822007:0.text: Harrin and I used to serve together in the Heroic Order.
say:6:1720822007:0.source_cn: 我和哈里斯，过去算是在骑士团的同僚。
say:6:1720822007:0.male: Harrin and I used to serve together in the Heroic Order.
say:6:1720822007:0.female: Harrin and I used to serve together in the Heroic Order.

say:7:1720822008:1.text: That was a long time ago. Now I'm just a humble gravekeeper.
say:7:1720822008:1.source_cn: 都是很久以前的事了。现在我只是一个普通的守墓人。

say:8:1720822009:1.text: You didn't come all the way to Vina Cemetery just to reminisce, did you?
say:8:1720822009:1.male: You didn't come all the way to Vina Cemetery just to reminisce, did you?
say:8:1720822009:1.female: You didn't come all the way to Vina Cemetery just to reminisce, did you?

choice_prompt:9:1720822009.text: You didn't come all the way to Vina Cemetery just to reminisce, did you?
choice_prompt:9:1720822009.source_cn: 维伦，你和<male>他</male><female>她</female>来维纳尔墓园，应该不单单是来找我叙旧的吧。
choice_prompt:9:1720822009.male: You didn't come all the way to Vina Cemetery just to reminisce, did you?
choice_prompt:9:1720822009.female: You didn't come all the way to Vina Cemetery just to reminisce, did you?

say:10:1720822010:1.text: It's usually delivered by a raven. I wonder why...
say:10:1720822010:1.source_cn: 工资？之前都是乌鸦来送，今天怎么……

say:11:1720822011:1.text: Is this a part of your "trade"?
say:11:1720822011:1.source_cn: 这是你们在做的“交易”的一部分？

narration:12:1720822012:1.text: You tell Harrin that you wish to learn about Valen's past through this trade with Eryndor.
narration:12:1720822012:1.male: You tell Harrin that you wish to learn about Valen's past through this trade with Eryndor.
narration:12:1720822012:1.female: You tell Harrin that you wish to learn about Valen's past through this trade with Eryndor.

say:13:1720822013:1.text: I see. I think I understand why he sent you to me. He always did have a peculiar sense of humor.
say:13:1720822013:1.source_cn: 原来如此。我大概明白先生让你们来找我的用意了。
say:13:1720822013:1.male: I see. I think I understand why he sent you to me. He always did have a peculiar sense of humor.
say:13:1720822013:1.female: I see. I think I understand why he sent you to me. He always did have a peculiar sense of humor.

choice_prompt:14:1720822013.text: I see. I think I understand why he sent you to me. He always did have a peculiar sense of humor.
choice_prompt:14:1720822013.source_cn: 原来如此。我大概明白先生让你们来找我的用意了。
choice_prompt:14:1720822013.male: I see. I think I understand why he sent you to me. He always did have a peculiar sense of humor.
choice_prompt:14:1720822013.female: I see. I think I understand why he sent you to me. He always did have a peculiar sense of humor.

say:15:1720822014:1.text: It seems you understand his intent. He likes people to work for their answers.
say:15:1720822014:1.source_cn: 嗯，看来你也理解先生的用意了。
say:15:1720822014:1.male: It seems you understand his intent. He likes people to work for their answers.
say:15:1720822014:1.female: It seems you understand his intent. He likes people to work for their answers.

say:16:1720822015:1.text: I'll cooperate. I do know something about Valen's past.
say:16:1720822015:1.source_cn: 既然是交易的一部分，我会配合。关于维伦的过去，我的确知...
say:16:1720822015:1.male: I'll cooperate. I do know something about Valen's past.
say:16:1720822015:1.female: I'll cooperate. I do know something about Valen's past.

say:18:1720822017:1.text: Asking for my permission? Well, I'm usually very private, you know. But since it's for <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll make an exception.
say:18:1720822017:1.source_cn: 是想征求我的意见吗？没办法，我虽然十分注重隐私，但谁叫...
say:18:1720822017:1.male: Asking for my permission? Well, I'm usually very private, you know. But since it's for <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll make an exception.
say:18:1720822017:1.female: Asking for my permission? Well, I'm usually very private, you know. But since it's for <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll make an exception.

say:19:1720822018:1.text: No. I'm asking whether you wish to step away.
say:19:1720822018:1.source_cn: 不。我只是问你是否需要回避。

say:20:1720822019:0.text: ... Thank you, but there's no need. If it's my story, I may as well hear how it's being told.

say:22:1720822020:1.text: Then let's begin. I'm talking about Valen's past, from ten years ago when he joined the Heroic Order.
say:22:1720822020:1.source_cn: 好。那么，我们就开始吧。我要说的是十年前，维伦加入骑士...

say:23:1720822021:1.text: Back then, I hadn't retired yet. I'd been pulled from the front lines after the Second Divine War due to old injuries, and reassigned to patrol duty in the capital.
say:23:1720822021:1.source_cn: 那时我还没有退伍，只是因为在第二次神魔大战中的旧伤退下...
say:23:1720822021:1.male: Back then, I hadn't retired yet. I'd been pulled from the front lines after the Second Divine War due to old injuries, and reassigned to patrol duty in the capital.
say:23:1720822021:1.female: Back then, I hadn't retired yet. I'd been pulled from the front lines after the Second Divine War due to old injuries, and reassigned to patrol duty in the capital.

say:24:1720822022:1.text: The capital was recovering in the war's aftermath. Life was generally stable. The only real headache was a little troublemaker causing issues in the lower district.
say:24:1720822022:1.source_cn: 王都还在战争的余韵中休养生息，日子整体还算安稳。要说有...
say:24:1720822022:1.male: The capital was recovering in the war's aftermath. Life was generally stable. The only real headache was a little troublemaker causing issues in the lower district.
say:24:1720822022:1.female: The capital was recovering in the war's aftermath. Life was generally stable. The only real headache was a little troublemaker causing issues in the lower district.

say:25:1720822023:1.text: Young as he was, he already had a whole repertoire of bad habits. Fraud, gambling... you name it.
say:25:1720822023:1.source_cn: 小小年纪就学会了一身的旁门左道。欺诈、赌牌……无所不及。
say:25:1720822023:1.male: Young as he was, he already had a whole repertoire of bad habits. Fraud, gambling... you name it.
say:25:1720822023:1.female: Young as he was, he already had a whole repertoire of bad habits. Fraud, gambling... you name it.

say:26:1720822024:1.text: For some reason, he had a particular grudge against the Heroic Order. He even rounded up other troubled kids to cause chaos.
say:26:1720822024:1.source_cn: 不知为何，他尤其讨厌骑士团，甚至还集结了其他问题少年一...
say:26:1720822024:1.male: For some reason, he had a particular grudge against the Heroic Order. He even rounded up other troubled kids to cause chaos.
say:26:1720822024:1.female: For some reason, he had a particular grudge against the Heroic Order. He even rounded up other troubled kids to cause chaos.

say:27:1720822025:1.text: He never committed any serious crimes, but the trouble he caused rivaled that of major criminals.
say:27:1720822025:1.source_cn: 虽然还只是个未成年的小孩，也没犯下过什么大罪，造成的恶...
say:27:1720822025:1.male: He never committed any serious crimes, but the trouble he caused rivaled that of major criminals.
say:27:1720822025:1.female: He never committed any serious crimes, but the trouble he caused rivaled that of major criminals.

say:28:1720822026:1.text: The capital ordered his arrest, but he slipped away every time.
say:28:1720822026:1.source_cn: 王都下了命令，要把他缉拿归案。但他凭借一身本领，次次都...
say:28:1720822026:1.male: The capital ordered his arrest, but he slipped away every time.
say:28:1720822026:1.female: The capital ordered his arrest, but he slipped away every time.

say:29:1720822027:1.text: Until one day, he crossed paths with General Hogan, who had just returned to the capital. That was the first time he was caught.
say:29:1720822027:1.source_cn: 直到有一天，他撞上了回宫述职的霍根将军。在将军那里，那...
say:29:1720822027:1.male: Until one day, he crossed paths with General Hogan, who had just returned to the capital. That was the first time he was caught.
say:29:1720822027:1.female: Until one day, he crossed paths with General Hogan, who had just returned to the capital. That was the first time he was caught.

say:32:1720822028:0.text: The suspect has been brought in. Shall we—
say:32:1720822028:0.source_cn: 将军，犯人已经抓获，已经带回驻地了。您看，是否需要……

say:33:1720822029:1.text: Keep him here for now. Don't rough him up, and don't lock him up.
say:33:1720822029:1.source_cn: 先让那孩子留在驻地，别对他动粗，也别关押他。

say:34:1720822030:1.text: I want to talk to him.

say:36:1720822032:1.text: Harrin... I want to recruit him.
say:36:1720822032:1.source_cn: 哈里斯，我想把他收入麾下，让他加入骑士团。

say:38:1720822034:2.text: I've read his file. You've seen it too, he's no hardened criminal.
say:38:1720822034:2.source_cn: 我看过他的档案记录。哈里斯，你也能看出，他不是什么穷凶...

say:39:1720822035:1.text: He's a loyal and capable young man. A talented swordsman with sharp instincts. More importantly, he's a young man in need of guidance.
say:39:1720822035:1.source_cn: 他是个有情有义的人，是个兼具作战能力与技巧、很有天赋的...

say:40:1720822036:1.text: I'll speak with him first, then make a careful decision.
say:40:1720822036:1.source_cn: 安心，我会先和他谈谈，再谨慎做出决定。

say:41:1720822037:1.text: But if I deem him worthy, there will be no objections. As for the arrest order, I'll handle it myself.
say:41:1720822037:1.source_cn: 但如果我判断他的确能为骑士团所用，是个可塑之才，希望你...

say:44:1720822038:1.text: I never learned what they said, but the boy did join the Heroic Order.
say:44:1720822038:1.source_cn: 我不知道将军和他具体的对话过程，但后来，他的确加入了骑士团。
say:44:1720822038:1.male: I never learned what they said, but the boy did join the Heroic Order.
say:44:1720822038:1.female: I never learned what they said, but the boy did join the Heroic Order.

say:45:1720822039:1.text: A few years later, he followed the General to Holistone.
say:45:1720822039:1.source_cn: 几年后，他又追随将军离开王都，去了圣石镇。
say:45:1720822039:1.male: A few years later, he followed the General to Holistone.
say:45:1720822039:1.female: A few years later, he followed the General to Holistone.

choice_prompt:46:1720822039.text: A few years later, he followed the General to Holistone.
choice_prompt:46:1720822039.source_cn: 几年后，他又追随将军离开王都，去了圣石镇。
choice_prompt:46:1720822039.male: A few years later, he followed the General to Holistone.
choice_prompt:46:1720822039.female: A few years later, he followed the General to Holistone.

say:47:1720822040:1.text: Yes. Hard to believe, isn't it?
say:47:1720822040:1.male: Yes. Hard to believe, isn't it?
say:47:1720822040:1.female: Yes. Hard to believe, isn't it?

say:48:1720822042:1.text: The next time I saw him was after I retired.
say:48:1720822042:1.source_cn: 再次和维伦见面，已经是我退伍之后的事了。
say:48:1720822042:1.male: The next time I saw him was after I retired.
say:48:1720822042:1.female: The next time I saw him was after I retired.

say:49:1720822043:1.text: My old wounds worsened, and I had no choice but to leave the Order. It was Mr. Eryndor who offered me this post, tending the cemetery where my wife rests.
say:49:1720822043:1.source_cn: 我旧伤复发，无法再继续任职，离开了骑士团。是埃德加先生...
say:49:1720822043:1.male: My old wounds worsened, and I had no choice but to leave the Order. It was Mr. Eryndor who offered me this post, tending the cemetery where my wife rests.
say:49:1720822043:1.female: My old wounds worsened, and I had no choice but to leave the Order. It was Mr. Eryndor who offered me this post, tending the cemetery where my wife rests.

say:50:1720822044:1.text: When I saw Valen again, I thought he had betrayed the General. Thankfully, I was mistaken. He had become a true knight.
say:50:1720822044:1.source_cn: 看到维伦时，说实话，我以为他背叛了将军。好在是我想岔了...
say:50:1720822044:1.male: When I saw Valen again, I thought he had betrayed the General. Thankfully, I was mistaken. He had become a true knight.
say:50:1720822044:1.female: When I saw Valen again, I thought he had betrayed the General. Thankfully, I was mistaken. He had become a true knight.

say:52:1720822045:1.text: Ahem... You sound just like the General used to. Has anyone ever told you two have the same disappointed dad voice?
say:52:1720822045:1.source_cn: 咳咳……恕我冒昧，这话听上去像是将军才会说的。哈里斯，...

say:53:1720822046:1.source_cn: 大概是因为我和将军年纪相仿吧。

say:54:1720822047:1.text: Now, that's all I know. I should return to my work. Thank you for delivering my wages.
say:54:1720822047:1.source_cn: 我知道的只有这些。现在我要继续打扫了。多谢你们帮我送工...

choice:46:1:2.text: So that's how he joined the knights!
choice:46:1:2.source_cn: 这就是维伦加入骑士团的契机
choice:46:1:2.male: So that's how he joined the knights!
choice:46:1:2.female: So that's how he joined the knights!

choice:14:0:1.text: Do you know about Valen's past?
choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 难道你知道维伦的过去？
choice:14:0:1.male: Do you know about Valen's past?
choice:14:0:1.female: Do you know about Valen's past?

choice:14:1:2.text: He wants me to ask people one by one...
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 原来埃德加是想让我自己逐一去问……
choice:14:1:2.male: He wants me to ask people one by one...
choice:14:1:2.female: He wants me to ask people one by one...

choice:14:2:3.text: Just like when I investigated the "spider"!
choice:14:2:3.source_cn: ……就像当时询问“蜘蛛”的意象一样
choice:14:2:3.male: Just like when I investigated the "spider"!
choice:14:2:3.female: Just like when I investigated the "spider"!

choice:9:0:1.text: Eryndor asked me to deliver something.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 埃德加让我帮忙送东西
choice:9:0:1.male: Eryndor asked me to deliver something.
choice:9:0:1.female: Eryndor asked me to deliver something.

say:57:1720822005:1.text: I told you already, don't listen to Florian.
say:57:1720822005:1.source_cn: 都和你说了，别听佛里那家伙的，我可没对你吹牛。
say:57:1720822005:1.male: I told you already, don't listen to Florian.
say:57:1720822005:1.female: I told you already, don't listen to Florian.

say:58:1720822006:0.text: We don't know each other from the Solitaries.
say:58:1720822006:0.source_cn: 不过我们不是在隐士认识的。
say:58:1720822006:0.male: We don't know each other from the Solitaries.
say:58:1720822006:0.female: We don't know each other from the Solitaries.

choice:4:1:2.text: You sure have tons of old friends.
choice:4:1:2.male: You sure have tons of old friends.
choice:4:1:2.female: You sure have tons of old friends.
